title: Etale cover carrying representatives of a pro-etale local Isom section
statement: For a scheme X, an étale object V over X, a commutative ring B, and derived objects A,D on X's étale site, assume D is bounded below [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. Every section of the pro-étale presheaf of derived local isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf] between the comparison pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison] of A and D over V is represented by actual derived isomorphisms on an étale covering of V.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 00WJ; local surjectivity of Isom sheafification on an étale object

proof.text: Use the canonical equivalence between the localized pro-etale site over V and the small pro-etale site of V.left. The generic restrictionComparison construction identifies inverse image along V.hom with overPullback followed by this equivalence.

Derive the canonical comparison/pullback square and the restriction isomorphism. Applying the derived slice equivalence to the supplied presheaf section gives an isomorphism between the comparison pullbacks of the etale restrictions A|V and D|V.

Exact etale restriction preserves the lower bound of D. The fixed-module derived comparison Hom bijection with bounded-below target lifts the hom component to A|V -> D|V. Exact comparison reflects isomorphisms: its cohomology comparison transports invertibility to each underived comparison of a cohomology map, and the underived fully faithful functor reflects invertibility. Therefore the lift is an isomorphism.
Take the singleton identity etale cover of V.left. Restrict the lifted isomorphism along each canonical arrow to V using localIsomorphismMap. This also applies to the empty scheme.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived; bounded-below derived comparison, together with localization and exact pullback.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_iso_cover_of_proetale_local_iso_section
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Etale)
    {B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing B]
    (A D : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (hD : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus D)
    (s : (derivedLocalIsoPresheaf (ProEt.topology X) B
      ((derivedComparison X B).obj A)
      ((derivedComparison X B).obj D)).obj
        (op ((toProEt X).obj V))) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage V.left,
      ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
        Nonempty ((localIsomorphismRestriction X B
          (Etale.mk (𝒰.f i ≫ V.hom))).obj A ≅
          (localIsomorphismRestriction X B
            (Etale.mk (𝒰.f i ≫ V.hom))).obj D)

statement_change.old_statement: For a scheme X, an étale object V over X, commutative ring B, and derived objects A,D on X's étale site, every section of the pro-étale presheaf of derived local isomorphisms between the comparison pullbacks of A and D over V is represented by actual derived isomorphisms on an étale covering of V.
statement_change.what: The former arbitrary-target statement does not follow from local surjectivity of sheafification: a pro-etale cover cannot in general be refined by an etale cover, and the input is already an actual derived Isom presheaf section. Add the bounded-below target hypothesis needed by the existing derived comparison Hom bijection. The finite-level consumer already assumes D bounded, so its statement is unchanged.

old_proof.text: Apply local surjectivity of sheafification to the supplied pro-étale Isom section, simultaneously to its morphism and inverse components. Refine the resulting local representatives to a common étale cover. The two inverse equations are preserved under restriction, so each member of this cover carries an actual derived isomorphism.
